description:
LWK are delighted to bring No. 88, an exceptionally well-presented two-bedroom apartment to the market for sale. Located in Smithfield this apartment offers superior, low-maintenance living in a highly regarded development, conveniently located just minutes from the city centre.  

Combining generous accommodation, modern finishes, excellent transport links with a prime city location, this attractive apartment is sure to generate significant interest from discerning purchasers seeking a stylish home in the heart of Dublin.

Smithfield Market is a highly sought-after area, offering residents a vibrant city lifestyle with every amenity on their doorstep. This stunning apartment, complete with Concierge service is sure to impress and will appeal to first time buyers, investors and professionals alike.

The stylish apartment briefly comprises of entrance hallway leading to a sizable open-plan kitchen, dining and living area. The tastefully upgraded kitchen is fitted with an abundance of base and eye-level units, providing excellent storage, complete with kitchen island adding a sleek and modern finish. The generous living and dining space enjoys direct access to the private balcony, creating an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining guests.
Two spacious double bedroom feature fitted wardrobes, providing ample storage space, the main bedroom has direct access to a private balcony. The large family bathroom is finished to a high standard with quality sanitary ware, completing the accommodation.  

**Freshly painted, this stunning apartment comes with the benefit of vacant possession enabling immediate occupancy for successful purchasers**

 Smithfield Market is a well-maintained and professionally managed development that has become one of Dublin's most desirable residential addresses. Residents benefit from secure access and beautifully maintained communal areas, while the surrounding neighbourhood offers an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, bars, supermarkets and leisure facilities.

The location is exceptionally convenient, with the Luas Red Line just a short stroll away, providing easy access to the city centre, Heuston Station and beyond. Numerous Dublin Bus routes serve the area, while the city centre is within walking distance. Popular landmarks including Smithfield Square, the Jameson Distillery, the Four Courts, Phoenix Park and TU Dublin Grangegorman campus are all easily accessible, further enhancing the appeal of this superb property.

Early viewing is highly recommended.  

•	Stunning upgraded apartment with Concierge Service
•	Secure, highly regarded development
•	Excellent BER rating B
•	Private balcony and communal roof garden
•	Prime location close to LUAS
•	Sizeable 70 Sq Metres
